theme: An open day with the girls at Jen's — one call, a few things to close.
greeting: The girls are with Jen this stretch, so it's a quiet solo day in Portland. Only one thing is fixed on the calendar; the rest of the day is yours to spend on the errands and calls that have been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia's PRI call window is today
needsAttention.detail: She offered to talk Monday 12:00-14:00 your time or Thursday, and is waiting on you to pick a slot. If you want the Monday option, it closes this afternoon.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Mike's pre-op instructions
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland; your Todoist prep list has today as the day to confirm fasting, NSAIDs, and meds with the surgeon's office. The task is 3 days overdue.

needsAttention.title: Croatia flights still unbought
needsAttention.detail: The 'buy flights to Croatia' task in your travel list has been overdue since Friday; fares tend to firm up the longer this waits.

schedule.title: Call with Mike
schedule.detail: Dan and Mike follow up — you're calling him.

flagged.title: Two LinkedIn messages awaiting you
flagged.detail: Peter, and Abhishek Tiwary (Global Head of People at KPMG Delivery Network), are both flagged as waiting for your reply on LinkedIn.

flagged.title: Recruiter asks you to confirm work authorization
flagged.detail: A sourcehire.app message about an SVP Global Public Policy role (REQ64085) asks you to confirm visa/sponsorship status — worth verifying it's a legitimate employer before responding.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up tomorrow
flagged.detail: Virtual visit with Dr. Jennifer Snowden, Tuesday Aug 18 at 10:00 AM EDT.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley proxy notices
flagged.detail: Two proxyvote.com notices on your holdings arrived over the weekend, if you vote your shares.

flagged.title: Mike's Sustainalytics idea
flagged.detail: Mike flagged that Morningstar is closing Sustainalytics' stewardship business and floated reaching out to its now-abandoned clients — cc'd to you and Karapetyan, no reply needed yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — NYT Cooking, WSJ, New Yorker, Folio, Fog Linen, Amtrak points, and a Nautilus sailing note.
inbox.clear: Nothing new is unanswered from your own sent threads.

resolved.title: Susan / Flora lunch wrapped
resolved.detail: You sent your thank-you note Aug 12 after meeting Susan and her wife; nothing is owed on that thread.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: The morning is wide open, with three overdue to-dos — surgery prep, flights, and the destination edit — waiting since Friday.
One call anchors the day at 2 with Mike, then the afternoon reopens.
A quiet close; tomorrow starts with the 10 AM Talkiatry follow-up.
